{{Recipe}}
==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Liter|litre]] [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
*¼ cup [[Cookbook:Semolina|semolina]] flour
*[[Cookbook:Clarified Butter|Ghee]]
*Water
==Procedure==

#[[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the milk until it reduces to half of its original volume.
#[[Cookbook:Roasting|Roast]] the semolina until light brown. 
#Mix the all-purpose flour and milk into the toasted semolina to make a [[Cookbook:Batter|batter]]. It should be smooth and lump-free.
#Heat the ghee in a [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]].
#Use a circular pouring motion to pour batter in the pan and make a small pancake.
#Keep turning over. Take care that it does not become crisp or harsh.
#Make a sugar [[Cookbook:Syrup|syrup]] of good consistency. Dip the malpua in the syrup.
#Serve.
